title: centaurea boissieri var. pinae
intro: Centaurea boissieri var. pinae, commonly known as a type of thistle, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea boissieri var. pinae include acting as a vulnerary to promote wound healing, an expectorant to relieve respiratory issues, and a diuretic to aid in urinary function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
